head_commit.message:
psc0: continue exact fixed point from authenticated N1 and C1 evidence

Retain the cancelled 1fa run and its completed N1/C1/C2 receipts. Add a pinned-source continuation of the existing fixed-point command with a longer job budget, authenticate the full carried archive and recipe, and keep provider admission mandatory. Update AI work state and preserve all open strict disposition flags.
